column1: # boru Language Specification: comment forms (NUR025 fix)
# The parser accepts exactly three comment forms: `# text` (line),
# `// text` (line), and `/* text */` (block, may span lines). The
# historically-documented `## text ##` block form DOES NOT EXIST — a
# `##` opens an ordinary `#` line comment (the rest of the line is
# ignored; the second `##` closes nothing). REFERENCE.md §Comments
# documents the real set; these rows pin it.

column3: …so everything after `#` is gone, including calls
`/* */` is the block form — the call survives around it
a block comment can sit between a word and its args
`##` is NOT a block opener: it is a `#` line comment, so the rest of the line is ignored
an unclosed block comment is a loud syntax_error
